name: Kanlungan
desc: Concept for a premium interior design studio and curated furniture shop. The brief sets two services, seven shop categories and the rule for what the shop is allowed to sell.

p: [Who it was for and what they needed, in two or three sentences.]

The studio is fictional, so the work so far is the brief. It locks two services, Full-Service Furnishing and a Design-Only Interior Package, and splits the shop into seven categories from seating to art. Collections run three ways: by room first, then by mood, then by material.
Every piece has to pass one test. Would Kanlungan confidently specify it in one of its own finished spaces?
[The result: numbers if you have them, or what people said.]
